message.content:
Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known to offer vegetarian (and sometimes vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu; many curries can be made vegetarian upon request. |
| **Siam Square** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Has a “Vegetarian” section on its menu; also offers tofu pad thai and vegetable spring rolls. |
| **Thai Basil** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu; includes dishes like green curry with vegetables and tofu. |
| **Mango Tree** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Provides a vegetarian menu; you can also customize many dishes to be vegetarian. |
| **The Thai House** | 1400 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Offers a separate vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegetarian if requested. |

All of these restaurants are located in the West Loop area, which has a high concentration of Thai eateries. If you’re looking for something more upscale or a different neighborhood, let me know and I can suggest alternatives!
